api_key.description: StaticForm API key. May also be set with the `STATICFORM_API_KEY` environment variable. Create one under Settings → API Keys in the dashboard.

base_url.description: Base URL of the StaticForm API. Defaults to `https://api.staticform.app`. May also be set with the `STATICFORM_BASE_URL` environment variable.

block.description: Manage [StaticForm](https://staticform.app) forms, API keys, and integrations as code. The provider authenticates with a StaticForm API key (`sf_live_` or `sf_test_`).

expires_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 expiration timestamp (e.g. `2027-01-01T00:00:00Z`). Omit for a non-expiring key. Immutable; changing it forces a new key.

form_ids.description: Form IDs to scope the key to. Omit for all of the user's forms. Updatable in place.

key.description: The plaintext API key. Available only immediately after creation.

key_hint.description: Last characters of the key, for identification.

permissions.description: Permission names to scope the key to. Omit for all of the creating user's permissions. Updatable in place.

block.description: A StaticForm API key. The plaintext key is returned only at creation time and stored in state; mark your state as sensitive accordingly.

form_id.description: Form to add the collaborator to.

user_id.description: User ID, once the invitation is accepted.

block.description: A collaborator on a form, managed by email. Creating the resource sends an invitation; the invitee must accept it out of band. Permission changes apply once the invitation is accepted.

mail_from_subdomain.description: MAIL FROM subdomain label (defaults to `bounces`). Empty string skips MAIL FROM configuration.

block.description: A managed sending domain (Amazon SES). Publish the returned DKIM records in DNS to verify it. Verification is asynchronous: apply does not block on it; the `status` attribute reflects the latest state on refresh.

captcha_secret_key.description: Captcha secret key. Required when `captcha_type` is not `None`. Write-only: the value is sent on create/update but never read back into state, so importing a form does not capture it and an apply never overwrites the existing secret unless you set this explicitly.

enable_honeypot.description: Enable the honeypot spam trap field.

expected_languages.description: ISO 639-2/T codes (3 lowercase letters) allowed when language detection is on.

id.description: Form ID. This is the value to POST submissions to.

language_detection_fields.description: Field names to run language detection against. Empty means all text fields.

server_submission_secret.description: Secret required to submit to a ServerSide form. Only set when `submission_mode = "ServerSide"`.

submission_mode.description: `ClientSide` (browser submissions, full spam protection) or `ServerSide` (backend submissions, requires the server secret).

tags.description: Up to 20 tags (1-50 chars each) for organizing forms.

name.description: Field name. Lowercase, starts with a letter, `[a-z0-9_]`.

options.description: UI/behaviour options (string values): `options` (Enum, required — JSON array of choices, e.g. `["Small","Large"]`); `allowMultiple` (Enum, `true`/`false` for multi-select); `isTextarea` (Text, `true`/`false` to render a multiline textarea); `maxFiles` (File, max number of files per submission).

rule.description: Validation rule: `None`, `Email`, `Website`, `Number`, `PositiveNumber`, `NumberRange`, `Before`, `After`, `Between`, `FileExtension`, or `FileSize`. Some rules require matching `validation_config` keys.

validation_config.description: Validation parameters (string values) keyed by rule: `minLength`/`maxLength` (Text, character bounds); `min`/`max` (Number, rule `NumberRange`); `before`/`after` (Date/Datetime, ISO-8601, rules `Before`/`After`/`Between`); `extensions` (File, rule `FileExtension`, comma-separated without dots, e.g. `pdf,doc,docx`); `maxFileSizeBytes` (File, rule `FileSize`, size in bytes).

block.description: An input field. Order is preserved.

customer_email_field_name.description: Name of the email field whose value prefills the Stripe Checkout email. When omitted, the first field with the email validation rule is used.

amount_field_name.description: Number field whose value is the charge.

block.description: Amount-from-field rules (mode `FieldAmount`).

amount_cents.description: Charge amount in the smallest currency unit.

block.description: Fixed-amount pricing rules (mode `Fixed`).

field_name.description: Enum field whose selected option sets the price.

price_map.description: Map of option value to price (smallest currency unit).

quantity_field_name.description: Optional number field used as a quantity multiplier.

block.description: Line items priced from fields (mode `LineItems`).

Stripe payment collection (Pro plan). At most one block. Requires a Stripe connection ID. When set, a `redirect` block with both `success` and `error` is required, because paid forms can only respond with an HTTP redirect (the buyer returns from Stripe Checkout via a redirect).
Redirect behaviour after submission (client-side forms only). Required with both `success` and `error` when a `payment` block is present.

body_builder_state.description: Email: optional JSON state for the dashboard's visual email builder. `body_template` is the source of truth for what is sent; set this only to round-trip the visual builder.

body_template.description: Email body (HTML) or webhook request body. Supports `{{token}}` placeholders (spaces inside the braces are allowed): field values `{{fieldName}}` or `{{form.fieldName}}`; form metadata `{{formName}}`, `{{formId}}`, `{{submissionId}}`; all answers `{{submissionData}}` (formatted) or `{{submissionDataJson}}` (JSON object); date/time `{{timestamp}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{time}}` with optional zone and format, e.g. `{{timestamp:Europe/Amsterdam|yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm|notz}}` (`:zone` IANA/Windows timezone, `|format` .NET format string, `|notz` drops the ` UTC` suffix); and, when a `payment` block is present, `{{payment.amount}}`, `{{payment.amountCents}}`, `{{payment.currency}}`, `{{payment.status}}`, `{{payment.stripePaymentIntentId}}`, `{{payment.stripeCheckoutSessionId}}`. For email this is the rendered content sent; for webhooks it is the request body.

email_domain_id.description: Email: send via a verified managed domain (`staticform_email_domain` ID). Mutually exclusive with `smtp_connection_id`.

from_email.description: Email: From address (managed-domain path only; ignored for SMTP).

from_name.description: Email: From display name (managed-domain path only; ignored for SMTP).

include_created_at.description: Google Sheets: include a created-at column.

include_submission_id.description: Google Sheets: include a submission ID column.

recipient.description: Email: recipient(s), comma-separated. Supports the same `{{token}}` placeholders as `body_template` (e.g. `{{form.email}}` to send to an address submitted in the form).

smtp_connection_id.description: Email: send via a BYO SMTP connection (`staticform_smtp_connection` ID). Mutually exclusive with `email_domain_id`.

subject.description: Email: subject. Supports the same `{{token}}` placeholders as `body_template` (e.g. `{{formName}}`, `{{form.email}}`, `{{timestamp}}`).

webhook_url.description: Webhook: target URL. Supports the same `{{token}}` template variables as `body_template` (e.g. `https://api.example.com/users/{{form.username}}`); substituted values are URL-encoded automatically.

write_header_if_empty.description: Google Sheets: write a header row if the sheet is empty.

form_field_name.description: Name of the form field to map from.

show_form_id.description: Show the form ID in the footer (Agency).

block.description: Email: customize the StaticForm email wrapper (colors, logo, header/footer, dark mode). At most one block.

field_name.description: Name of the file field to attach.

block.description: Optional: only attach when these conditions match.
Email: attach an uploaded file-field's file (Pro plan).

property_type.description: Notion property type: `title`, `rich_text`, `email`, `phone_number`, `url`, `number`, `checkbox`, `date`, `select`, or `multi_select`. Unrecognized types fall back to `rich_text`.

block.description: Optional: only run when these conditions match (Pro plan).

content_type.description: MIME type. Computed when `source` is set.

file_name.description: Display file name. Computed when `source` is set.

file_size.description: File size in bytes. Computed when `source` is set.

s3_key.description: Object key in the form-uploads bucket. Computed when `source` is set.

source.description: Path to a local file to upload. Mutually exclusive with `s3_key`.

source_hash.description: Optional content hash (e.g. `filesha256(...)`); changing it re-uploads `source`.

block.description: Optional: only attach when these conditions match.
Email: attach a static file (Pro plan). Provide `source` to upload a local file automatically, or `s3_key` (+ metadata) to reference one already in the form-uploads bucket.
An action run on submission. `type` selects which fields apply.
A StaticForm form: its fields, spam protection, redirect behaviour, and submit actions (email, webhook, Google Sheets, Notion).

api_key.description: Notion internal integration token. Validated against Notion on create; stored encrypted, never returned.

revoked.description: Whether the connection has been revoked.

block.description: A Notion integration connection, created from an internal integration token. Referenced by `SyncNotionDatabaseAction` submit actions via its `id`. Attributes are immutable; changing any forces a new connection.

password.description: SMTP password. Stored in state, never returned by the API.

block.description: A bring-your-own SMTP connection for sending form emails. The server live-tests the credentials on create. Attributes are immutable; changing any forces a new connection.

key_mode.description: `live` or `test`, derived from the secret key.

secret_key.description: Stripe restricted secret key (`rk_...`). Verified against Stripe on create; stored encrypted, never returned.

webhook_configured.description: Whether a webhook secret is set.

webhook_secret.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (`whsec_...`). Updatable in place; stored encrypted, never returned.

block.description: A Stripe payment connection, created from a restricted secret key (`rk_...`). Referenced by a form's `payment` block via its `id`. The label and key are immutable; the webhook secret can be updated in place.

email_overage_enabled.description: Allow email overage charges beyond the plan quota.

email_quota_warning_enabled.description: Warn at 80%/95% of the email quota.

submit_action_failure_notification_enabl.description: Email the account when a submit action fails.

block.description: The authenticated account's notification settings. This is a singleton — one per account. Destroying it only removes it from state; it does not reset the account.
The permission names that can be granted to a `staticform_api_key`.

form_id.description: Filter logs to a single form.

block.description: Submit-action execution logs (read-only), optionally filtered by form.
Look up an existing StaticForm form by ID.
List all forms accessible to the API key.
List Google (Sheets) OAuth connections. Use a connection `id` in a form's `SyncGoogleSheetsAction`. Google connections are created interactively in the dashboard.
List Notion connections. Prefer the `staticform_notion_connection` resource to manage them; use this to reference connections created elsewhere.
List Stripe connections. Prefer the `staticform_stripe_connection` resource to manage them; use this to reference connections created elsewhere.

form_id.description: Form ID to read submissions from.

block.description: Read the (non-spam) submissions of a form. Read-only.
The account's current subscription (read-only).
The authenticated account's profile and plan capabilities (read-only). Use the `can_use_*` flags to gate features in your configuration.
